purpose: HALF(index2) operator DC and phase-placement identifiability audit; no hardware parameter fit and no production edits
scope: Mathematical and native-source invariants, retained carrier-only metadata only; no audio decode, download, synthesis demo, or listening preference experiment
methods: Directly compile the unchanged current Press78Engine.cpp into a research probe; use its preexisting friend test seam and callable local wave helper without editing production files.

Integrate one unit period with 262144 equally spaced samples; compare mean and Fourier coefficients h1..12 to independently derived half-sine series. This quadrature count is a numerical test resolution, not physical OPU precision.

Compare actual Voice::next with max(sin(phi),0) carrier-phase modulation at no feedback, instant attack, constant amplitude, three TLs, four carrier/modulator integer-ratio pairs, and MIDI36/60/84. Test source wiring only.

For a constant carrier-only half waveform, compare current output DC block responses for h and h-1/pi, with all other effects disabled; expected difference is (1/pi)*r^n. The 10 Hz coefficient is read from current code, not newly asserted hardware data.

Use fixed synthetic carrier/modulator phases to compare mean-preserving vs mean-subtracted modulation. Verify phase delta=8*g and finite-difference delta frequency=(4/pi)*dg/dt. A constant g creates no steady frequency delta. Test 48000 ticks, fixture g=.2, with a 100ms linear rise, 200ms hold, 100ms fall, remainder zero; fixture durations are arbitrary algebra tests, not hardware envelope predictions.

Compare post-output high-pass responses for coherent fixed synthetic fc=fm=125Hz, mod amplitude .2, one second, without optimizing anything. Require a nonzero difference even after 0.5s settling; this proves post-output DC filtering cannot substitute for mean subtraction before the nonlinear carrier lookup. It does not decide the hardware choice.

Reuse the exact previously published PSS680 carrier-table2 window 39.12..39.32s and frozen harmonic measurements. Compute ideal-vs-observed harmonic deltas, without fitting an output curve or interpreting residuals as quantization.
non_promotion_rules: No mathematical DC fact is promoted to measured OPU bias.
No current 48k update rate, TL law, 10Hz DC pole, 8*pi modulation index scale, phase reset, or feedback history is promoted to hardware fact.
No production default/engine edit is allowed from these tests; the carrier-only observation cannot resolve internal modulator DC.
